record.question: Post-procedure care after a myelogram typically includes which instruction?
options: Engage in strenuous activity immediately to circulate the contrast.
Lie flat for a prolonged period (e.g., 24 hours).
Fast for 12 hours after the procedure.
Rest with the head elevated (less than 30 degrees) for several hours and drink plenty of fluids.
record.explanation: Official final key: D — Rest with the head elevated (less than 30 degrees) for several hours and drink plenty of fluids.. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 8, printed Q8. Source limitation: The listed instructions include prolonged bed rest/head elevation and forced hydration, which are not a universal current post-myelography standard; postprocedure instructions depend on puncture technique and institutional protocol. No cited ACR standard supports a single listed instruction as generally required. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
